svg.title: Where each kind of data lives
svg.desc: Inside one server: the Java heap, off-heap mapped files, direct buffers and native memory; below it the local disk under the data folder and the operating system's page cache.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif
